answer: A process where the response to a stimulus reinforces or amplifies the original stimulus, moving the variable further from the set point until a specific outcome is achieved. answer: When blood glucose rises: beta cells of pancreatic islets secrete Insulin → cells take up glucose → blood glucose falls (negative feedback). When blood glucose falls: alpha cells secrete Glucagon → liver converts glycogen to glucose → blood glucose rises (negative feedback). These two hormones act antagonistically to maintain glucose homeostasis.
